title: ClinAuthBench v1: A Synthetic Inpatient Health Authorization Benchmark
description:
ClinAuthBench is a synthetic inpatient health authorization benchmark. V1 covers adult inpatient psychiatric authorization over dense 72-hour synthetic case documentation, testing whether language models can reason across multi-form documentation without asserting unsupported authorization claims.

Each of the 180 cases carries gold labels, evidence anchors, and an explicit set of tempting but unsupported conclusions a model should not claim (metadata.gold.do_not_claim). The v1 taxonomy labels current-versus-historical risk, contradiction, lower-level-of-care barrier reasoning, and missing, invalid, or stale structured evidence. Cases are generated using Markov Decision Process-style synthetic state transitions; cases 121-180 include probabilistic trajectory metadata.

Composition: 180 synthetic cases — 108 continued-stay, 72 safe or lower-level-of-care-ready, 22 contradiction or conflicting-documentation. 120 rule-based, 60 probabilistic.

Privacy and affiliation: ClinAuthBench is fully synthetic. It is not derived from, affiliated with, endorsed by, or representative of any healthcare provider, payer, employer, customer, EHR vendor, or real patient population. It contains no real patient records, chart text, PHI, or source-system identifiers. Results obtained on this benchmark should not be interpreted as clinical performance, payer-policy performance, or real-world authorization safety.
